jobs.name: s11_combo
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) at the pharmacy counter places a second small plain box next to the main medicine box and explains its benefit with a friendly open-palm gesture; the customer listens with interest and nods. Warm, caring mood. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels, price tags or text of any kind anywhere in the image; boxes are plain and unlabeled.
jobs.meaning: к средству логично добавить защиту — полнота помощи

jobs.name: s11_full
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. A customer walks away from the pharmacy counter with a complete paper bag holding two or three plain boxes, looking relieved and confident; the pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) behind the counter smiles, satisfied with a job well done. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels, price tags or text of any kind anywhere in the image; boxes are plain and unlabeled.
jobs.meaning: человек уходит не с половиной решения, а с полным
